objective: Falsify the incorrect next step of attempting a universal scope-completeness proof for the bounded P3 v3 prequalification implementation, while preserving its valid terminal/preflight evidence and isolating the actual uncovered synthesis scope.

code_bound_facts.fact: Candidate output contains selected_claims, uncertainty_claims, and terminal_authority only; it does not emit a natural-language or artifact synthesis.
code_bound_facts.consequence: Cannot by itself satisfy the broad contract action SELECT_ORGANIZE_AND_EXPRESS for arbitrary deliverable forms.

code_bound_facts.fact: Evidence is consumed as float(value) grouped by metric; claims require scalar threshold plus relation at_least or at_most.
code_bound_facts.consequence: Qualitative, categorical, relational, textual, multimodal, document-structural, and non-threshold evidence/claim relations are outside this implementation.

code_bound_facts.fact: Audience preference table contains only executive, engineer, auditor and only two preferred kinds per audience.
code_bound_facts.consequence: Open audience adaptation is not represented by the bounded route.

code_bound_facts.fact: Candidate does not consume objective semantics beyond task presence and does not consume explicit format/style constraints.
code_bound_facts.consequence: General objective-conditioned organization and arbitrary format/style compliance are outside this implementation.

code_bound_facts.fact: Input evidence may contain provenance but candidate output does not carry provenance.
code_bound_facts.consequence: General provenance-preserving synthesis cannot be established from this candidate alone.

code_bound_facts.fact: Bounded score_case checks exact selected_claims and uncertainty_claims plus budget; it does not directly score free-form expression, provenance emission, arbitrary formatting, or general decision-relevant compression.
code_bound_facts.consequence: The declared P3 required-check set is semantically sufficient as a specification, but this bounded preflight scorer is not an implementation of the whole declared check set.

code_bound_facts.fact: Independent preflight verification explicitly states PREQUALIFICATION_ONLY and does_not_prove WHOLE_OPEN_ENDED_CONTRACT_SCOPE_EQUIVALENCE.
code_bound_facts.consequence: Any universal scope promotion from P3 v3 would contradict its own verified authority boundary.
